horoscopes.horoscope: Today you will be focussed and unshakable in your work, The results will be noticeable by mid-day. In the evening you will meet one of your admirers and this will take a load off your shoulders. Ganesha predicts that if you are unmarried, you will meet someone remarkable. Thrill, chill and excite your lover this beautiful evening. After all, “love and be loved”- that will be your motto. You will be at your romantic best by the blessings of Ganesha. The day for you will begin on an enthusiastic note. However, by the time second half approaches, you will stabilize your thoughts, actions and think more practically. Health will be on your side so you will perform tasks in a better manner. The day does not look too good for financial matters as luck will favour you only if you work really hard. However, during the second half of the day, you stand chance to experience the stroke of luck. You will enjoy smooth working conditions. In order to gain monetary benefits in the evening, Ganesha advises you to be committed to your work during the first half of the day. Your energy will bring progress at work. Try to focus on your accuracy, reminds Ganesha.

You are likely to find yourself at odds with people today, says Ganesha. Avoid confrontations and arguments as it may lead to serious fights. Legal issues may creep up unexpectedly. Relax and spend some time with yourself to return to your charm and cheer. Delay the inauguration of important activities for another day, recommends Ganesha. Don’t discuss any issues or worries after returning home from the office. Spend the evening comfortably with your lover. Go to a park or a nearby restaurant with your beloved. You will be lucky to have some intimate moments with your sweetheart. The second half of the day will be much better than the first half. You may find yourself in a much better mood in the second half. You will be able to perform tasks with greater vigour and vitality in the second part. In the first half of the day, you shall be concerned about losses that you have incurred in the past. It will be difficult for you to stop thinking about your wrong financial decisions. You will be having a positive day at the workplace. You will be able to accomplish your pending tasks and successfully achieve your targets. Post lunch, you will impress your boss and colleagues with your crazy, exciting yet result-oriented new ideas.

You will be more emotional today and people might play with your feelings. Therefore you need to rein in your emotions today when it comes to dealing with people. However, you will meet people who will reciprocate your feelings with equal ardour, if not more, says Ganesha. With harmony prevailing at the love front, you and your partner should be more than happy. Both of you will be kind, trustworthy, honest and supportive to each other. A mutually stimulating period is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Since morning, you will be full of beans and thus no task will appear to be difficult or tiresome. But as the day progresses, you may experience small setbacks. Don’t worry – just take it in your stride, and move ahead. Certain errors made in the 2nd half may cost you dearly on the financial front. Today is not favourable for buying valuables. If you buy something, you will not be satisfied with the quality. The day will be fine if you can avoid getting into emotional dramas. You will be very confident and energetic and love to take responsibilities. Working zestfully, you shall be able to finish off pending tasks.

In all likelihood, today, you are likely to strike a balance between your professional and personal life, predicts Ganesha. The work will be interesting and stimulating, while your time with family will be peaceful and soothing. You will win your sweetheart being caring, nurturing and sensitive. It will eventually add harmony to your love life. Your efficiency level will zoom today and you shall therefore deliver better quality output. The quantity of work will also be more than expected. During the second half, your productivity may decrease, which indicates that you need a break – relax! Financial gains are indicated during second half of the day. Business transactions will go off smoothly. If you are into freelancing, you will be able to invest your time very productively. You may carry some impractical thoughts in the boardroom in the first part of the day but don’t worry. Luck will support you in the second half. Ganesha advises you to be slow and steady during meetings.

It is always a small world till you dream big! Ganesha foresees chances of you transcending your regular boundaries as you combine forces with people and conceive interests larger than what most people dream of. This route is not the easiest, in that it may be hard to convince people who see differently, especially conservative bosses. But with luck on your side, you shall see your ongoing business deals coming to happy conclusions. It would be prudent to hold your cards close and delay important decisions in the evening, advises Ganesha. Thank Ganesha for blessing you with an understanding partner, who won’t mind if you spend a few extra hours at work. You will be grateful to your partner who is not demanding, rather supporting you always to form a blissful married life. With your mood taking an upward swing, nothing will appear to be impossible. Tasks that others may take hours to complete, you shall do them in a jiffy. But, avoid conflicts with your seniors in office and elders at home. Ensure that there is no imbalance in bank account due to over-investment, advises Ganesha. The day indicates greater gains with relatively lesser amount of work, so you may consider yourself lucky. An action-packed day is waiting for you. High voltage or energetic tasks will excite you today. You will successfully execute R&D, QC or verification projects. Important meetings will also be on your agenda.

Ganesha foresees a strong probability that you will keep your feet firmly planted on the ground in the face of adversity. The afternoon sun may bring some good returns or much awaited results for you. Love and affection will bring tranquillity in your family life. There is a distinct possibility of new relationships developing later in the day, says Ganesha. There won’t be much progress or new excitement in your love life. Things will go smoothly unless you jeopardize the intensity of the relationship. You may be too analytical to enhance the zest of harmonious companionship. After working hard during the past few days, the time has come to take a small break. Going on a picnic will help to recharge your batteries, and refresh your mind – you can no longer bear the humdrum routine. You will be thinking more about money during the second half of the day. It is not being selfish, but simple logic that if you progress financially, your family or dependents will also feel more comfortable. Dedication and hard work will be the keywords for you today. You will also welcome and support new employees. Your health also needs to be taken care of. Eventually, you will end the day being a true blue perfectionist.

It’s not an easy ride for you today. Expect to undergo a range of emotions that might even make you feel distressed and emotional. However, your academic intelligence will bear some fruit over the course of the day. Also, your charisma will finally bedazzle that special someone in your life. Do not ignore a chance to give a facelift to your home, says Ganesha. A pleasurable time with your lover is possible only if you control your temper. You are likely to be talkative. Don’t come to the conclusion immediately. Understand the mental spirit of your partner and listen to him/her carefully. Your health will be okay. You will feel good during the first half of day. You will socialize and make a few phone calls. You will be appreciated by others. However, during the second part of the day you may feel a bit tired. Today you shall be thinking about matters related to inheritance, property, joint finances and expenses to follow during the days ahead. You need to control negative thinking and must not worry too much. Certain things may not go well today since your frank opinions may not impress others at the office. Try to be diplomatic while choosing subjects, tasks, making any comments or declaring any announcement. You need to back down to prove yourself later.

The planets indicate you won’t look before you leap, and commit to a hasty decision at work, says Ganesha. In the afternoon, all those efforts you put in will go down the drain. Expect to catch a seat all alone on a business trip, says Ganesha. In the evening, you may walk that extra mile to please your beloved. As the evening unfolds, a romantic rendezvous with your loved one will intoxicate your senses. You will woo your sweetheart over a romantic date and eventually develop an intense relationship. Stay in good mood and be full of energy. Be in good humour as far as possible. This way you will be able to complete pending tasks. Second part of the day is about performing thankless jobs. So, don’t expect much from others. You should change your daily routine in a way that your time becomes more productive. Spend less time on social network and medias and devote time to money generating activities. You will tend to be smarter and faster that keeps you ahead of others today at work. You will feel energetic, competitive and experience a sense of fulfillment with the number of pending tasks you finish. Techno-savvy guys can make the best use of this lucky day.

Ganesha sees you holding the fort to safeguard the interests of your loved ones. Afternoon may be reserved for undertaking a business trip. But a fun-n-frolic outing may well be a good option too! Expect to shell out a few extra bucks though, when you opt for a cosmetic make-over. Increased attention to your beloved will make him/her fall in love with you all over again. Keep it up in order to stabilize the relationship. Surprises, gifts, dine outs will definitely work in your favour now. So chill out! The day will be very good from the perspective of health and mood. You could do many tasks. However, this may take away your focus, so you can feel restless. At the end of the day, you may feel tired due to multitasking. You may be confident that you are going to remain lucky enough during the days ahead to be able to mint money. Post lunch time, you will be less aggressive about spending money. You might feel restless in the morning. You are likely to take more responsibilities at work and tend to mess up the things. Ganesha advises you to take up only one task at a time so that you don’t mess things up. Planning can certainly help you organise your work better.

The backbreaking work that you’ve been doing can drench out all your energy today. But, you’ll still be able to cross the finishing line and successfully complete your projects, marks Ganesha. The support and cooperation of your family and friends will be like an oxygen mask for you, as they will understand the hardships you’ve been facing. Your out-of-the-box approach in expressing your love will amaze your partner. You can welcome your partner to a beach, pool party, pub or corporate get together. Being honest with your loved one will ultimately enhance your trust factor in the relationship. The first half of the day could be lethargic however it will change by the second half. In the second half, you will get creative which will bring you back to good mood. Second half of the day is also good for doing sports activity. If you really want your finances to stabilize or grow, you must get into ‘direct action mode’ to earn money. You should be able to stay focused on financial graph during the second half of the day. Even if the first part of the day seems challenging, the latter half will be more favourable for you. Important meetings should be scheduled only after lunch, insists Ganesha. Be confident in professional dealings.

Good news about a loved one will bring on a festive mood. You only need an itsy-bitsy excuse to party, and that’s what you’ll do today! You will make new friends, and they will prove helpful in times of need. Ganesha suggests a candlelit dinner to round up a perfect day. You will be in a romantic mood but a cold response from your lover might put the fire off. Don’t worry even if you get a straightforward remark from your partner, suggests Ganesha. A little fun or your sense of humor can play a big role to turn your partner on. Lot many ideas will come to your mind in the morning. However, applying too much logic may tire you. During second half of the day, your mind will require rest. It will be in your favour to do some rejuvenating activity then. Mostly today, you will be thinking about other people’s progress, their money and their life. While it’s good to observe others, Ganesha advises you to learn from their life. Attention crazy juniors may try to deviate your attention at the workplace. During the second half of the day, you will be able to focus well and be able to achieve your targets or deadline. Ensure that you don’t forget to bring necessary changes, reminds Ganesha.

You are likely to be sweating today at work, and it is neither the weather nor an ill-fitting suit that is the cause, says Ganesha. You will try your best to get your views across, and the post-afternoon lunch siesta is probably the best time to hammer your point home because that is when your boss will have all the energy to argue against. However, conserve some of your energy for an action-filled evening with your heartthrob. You know what all work and no play can do to a man. Romantically speaking, it is a day to share your feelings with the one who makes your eyes sparkle. Be confident and let your loved one be confident through transparent relationship. Be open, honest and flexible with your partner, advises Ganesha. You will do lot many productive tasks in the first half of day. In the second half, you would think more practically. This will strike balance in your life and will impact your health positively because excessive flow of emotions often drain you, notes Ganesha. If you are planning an important meeting regarding financial negotiation on some project or assignment, Ganesha suggests you to choose first half of the day, as luck isn’t favouring you during the second half. You will be strong and confident and your get-up-and-go attitude urges you to take up new projects at the workplace. Though it will smooth your job complexities, the chattering of your colleagues may get on your nerves. Just focus on your primary responsibilities, advises Ganesha.
